_comment: Interview knowledge the DV-100 field_config cannot express. DV-100 is the primary form of the packet, so the nameIds chosen here are canonical - DV-109 and DV-110 mirror them for the values shared across the packet (case number, party names, court address, hearing date/time). Nineteen conditionals named gates with no matching field; the eleven with a real counterpart are retargeted below, and the remaining eight are genuine gates the form implies but never stores.
